answer: Each agent locks 70 credits and files a voyage log sealed with an onyx stamp. At the summit, any agent may prove two logs share a route hash and claim a bounty; verified, both bonds burn and the hunter takes 35. Logs cost 40+6(k-1) per shared route, so 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked, vs a 40,000 pool. A rented-voyage ring fails: a rented log bears its owner's onyx seal, and the mismatch burns both bonds. Honest agents pay 40 once.
